scenes.title: Hook
scenes.card: The timber look. Without the weight.
scenes.vo: Want the look of old timber beams, without the weight?

scenes.title: Meet Heritage Timber
scenes.vo: Meet Heritage Timber, from Ekena Millwork. | Each beam is molded in one piece, from real, weathered timber.

scenes.title: Textures
scenes.vo: Pick from six textures. | Mena. | Salvaged Timber. | Rustic Sawn. | Resawn Rip. | Reclaimed Axed Cut. | And Sanded Smooth.

scenes.title: Finishes
scenes.vo: Then a hand-stained finish. | Sandstone. | Kona Brown. | Vanilla Chai. | Warm Caramel. | Natural White Oak. | Smokey Brown. | Or primed, ready to paint.

scenes.title: Sizes and lengths
scenes.vo: Eight sizes, from three and a half inches square to nine and a half by eleven and a half. In lengths from four to twenty-four feet.

scenes.title: Hollow, easy install
scenes.vo: They're hollow, so they slide over a wood block on your ceiling, and can hide wiring.

scenes.title: Quick Ship
scenes.vo: And they ship fast. Stained beams in three to five business days. Primed, in about one to three.

scenes.title: End card
scenes.vo: Order a sample, and see it in your own light.
